purpose: Prevent lost work while allowing continuation turns to finish a real major stage instead of stopping on tiny PARTIAL checkpoints.

turn_boundary.major_milestone_definition: A major milestone is a named stage or explicit deliverable reaching a real terminal state for that turn, such as Stage2B CLOSED/PASS, Stage3C PASS, Stage4 PASS, Stage5 delivery, Stage6 acceptance, or a genuine BLOCKED state. Preflights, partial audits, shards, candidate tables, review batches and PARTIAL checkpoints are not major milestones by themselves.
turn_boundary.continue_request_rule: When the user asks to continue/resume (including repeated unattended continuation turns), keep working on the currently active major stage until it reaches PASS/CLOSED, a genuine BLOCKED state, a material authority conflict, or the hard tool/safety boundary. Do not intentionally stop merely because a sub-checkpoint was created.
turn_boundary.partial_checkpoint_rule: Intermediate checkpoints are recovery/resume aids. They may be persisted silently or compactly, but they must not be treated as completion, must not advance latest_completed_milestone, and must not trigger a user-facing ZIP/handoff unless the hard boundary, a real blocker, or the user explicitly requires it.
turn_boundary.after_major_completion: After the current major stage reaches PASS/CLOSED/BLOCKED, persist and send a visible final response before silently entering the next major stage, unless the user explicitly requested multi-stage execution.
turn_boundary.user_override: The user may explicitly request multi-stage execution; hard safety/tool limits and durable recovery still apply.

tool_budget.action_at_soft_budget: Do not stop solely because the soft budget was reached. Persist a lightweight in-progress resume point if useful, then continue the current major stage while the hard budget and safety constraints allow.
tool_budget.hard_rule: Do not exceed the hard external-operation budget unless stopping would risk losing already-produced work. If the current major stage is incomplete at the hard boundary, persist an exact IN_PROGRESS resume point and answer honestly; the next continuation turn resumes from it.
tool_budget.retry_rule: After one corrected retry, record the failed operation as PENDING/BLOCKED only if it genuinely prevents the current stage; otherwise continue unaffected work.

context_budget.rule: Read only relevant keys/ranges/files when possible. Avoid dumping very large PROJECT-STATE/README/checkpoint files into context when a targeted read or parsed summary is sufficient.
context_budget.large_output_rule: If a tool response is truncated or very large, switch to targeted retrieval instead of repeatedly requesting the whole resource.

persistence.git: Source, small metadata, manifests, hashes, policy, checkpoint summaries and durable coordination state
persistence.git_failure_rule: Respect bounded Git retry policy; mark persistence PENDING when needed and preserve the exact artifact/hash/resume point.

runtime_currentness.rule: Re-resolve CURRENT whenever runtime compatibility matters. Never inherit an old runtime from a content checkpoint merely because it was current when that checkpoint was written.

must_include: exact checkpoint/artifact or durable resume state when applicable
final_response_contract.anti_pattern: Do not end a continuation turn just because a PARTIAL/preflight/checkpoint exists. Do not present serial tiny checkpoints as meaningful progress.

resume_rule: A new chat/agent resumes from bootstrap + currentness/pins + PROJECT-STATE + relevant CHECKPOINT, not from reconstructing long chat history.

unattended_continuation_mode.trigger: An explicit continue/resume request in an active workstream, including repeated automated user turns such as Tampermonkey sending ادامه بده / continue.
unattended_continuation_mode.goal: Maximize meaningful progress on the current named stage, not maximize checkpoint count.
behavior: Resume from the newest valid state and continue the same major stage.
Do not emit a user-facing PARTIAL package merely because an intermediate analysis table or recovery checkpoint exists.
At soft budget, persist lightweight resume state when useful and continue.
At hard budget, persist exact resume state and answer IN_PROGRESS if the stage is still open.
On the next continuation turn, resume from that exact point rather than restarting analysis.
forbidden_patterns: Treating preflight, overlap scan, editorial batch, dependency review, semantic routing or similar substeps as completed major milestones.
Producing serial PARTIAL ZIPs that do not materially advance the named stage.
Stopping at the soft tool budget solely because a durable sub-checkpoint exists.
unattended_continuation_mode.no_background_claim: This mode advances only on actual user turns; it does not claim background execution between turns.

rollback.reason_preserved: The previous mode protected visible handoff after long turns. It is preserved intact in case the refined continuation mode causes worse reliability or overlong turns.
rollback.procedure: Restore the archived copy to EXECUTION-SAFETY-POLICY.json in both repositories, then mark MEM-025-CONTINUE-UNTIL-MAJOR-STAGE as ROLLED_BACK or SUPERSEDED. Do not delete the v1.1.0 history.
